test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

Some Spoons are Forks.

Some Tongs are Ladles.

All Ladles are Spoons.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Tongs are Spoons.

(II) Some Forks are Ladles.

(III) All Ladles are Fork.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and II follow.
Both Conclusions II and III follow.
Both Conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
**Explanation:**

We draw a Venn diagram from the given statements:

Some Spoons are Forks.

Some Tongs are Ladles.

All Ladles are Spoons.

Now we consider the given conclusions:

**(I) Some Tongs are Spoons **→ Follows</st
